title: For N>=2, angularly separated spectral ratios and nonzero real q,kappa with opposite inside/outside unit-circle magnitudes give absolute convergence of the nonstationary f_N,infinity Ruijsenaars series near its affine ratio origin
author: Edwin Langmann; Masatoshi Noumi; Junichi Shiraishi
work: Basic Properties of Non-Stationary Ruijsenaars Functions
source_version: Official SIGMA 16 (2020) article 105, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2020.105; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The key obligation is a uniform exponential bound on coefficients indexed by N partitions, despite infinitely many periodic spectral factors and potentially small denominators. The author separates angular and same-period factors, controls their integer exponents by partition inequalities and telescopes the complete product into a bound in total partition size. This provides an actual analytic convergence domain for a formal nonstationary special function and exceeds checking a simple power series by the ratio test.

source_check.note: The full original convergence Theorem 3.7 and complete author proof are retained, with the selected N>=2 branch recorded on the cover. Definitions of the explicitly selected periodic f_N,infinity series, the matrix/partition reindexing and its Appendix A.1 details, all Appendix B coefficient-estimate cases and the author-supplied Euler partition identity are included. Conversion to the separate original function and conjectural eigenfunction/duality claims are not counted. Existing approved human statement/proof/context/above-qualification decision copied from the frozen manifest and metadata; no new source or mathematical review.

proof_review.note: The complete Theorem3.7 convergence proof, the partition/matrix reindexing in Lemma3.5 and AppendixA.1, and every case of AppendixB’s Pochhammer estimates were read. The author uses angular separation to bound off-period denominators and opposite q/kappa magnitudes for same-period ones, checks the allowed exponents using partition monotonicity, telescopes the full coefficient product to (C1*C2)^|lambda|, and compares to the N-partition generating product. The existing Euler partition identity is background and also provided in AppendixD. Select convergence of the explicitly defined f_N,infinity series; eigenfunction, bispectral and elliptic T-operator claims remain conjectural and are excluded.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Exactly Theorem3.7 restricted to N>=2 and the f_N,infinity series of Definitions3.1 and3.3, with s_i nonzero, t nonzero fixed, some sigma>0 satisfying |sin(arg(s_i/s_j))|>sigma for all i<j, and nonzero real q,kappa such that either |q|<1<|kappa| or |kappa|<1<|q|. There exists rho>0 with absolute convergence when |p|<rho^N and all |x_(i+1)/x_i|<rho and |p*x_1/x_N|<rho; x_i are nonzero. The series is the explicitly printed periodic matrix/partition expansion; the original function conversion and asserted eigenfunction properties are not separate selected statements.
original_metadata.editorial_warning: Editorial source notice, separate from the author: AppendixB.2.3 first product (PDF p.20/native line1041) prints exponent n-theta-m+1 in its denominator, while LemmaB.1(c)/(B.7) and the immediately following product both use the unshifted exponent n-theta-m. Those explicit adjacent expressions fix the single stray +1. Original source pages retain it; no replacement estimate or independently supplied proof is inserted.
